decisions.why: Bath seats and grab rails are bathing and toileting aids—Blow Molded Shower Seats, grab bars.
Rollators, walkers, crutches—2203A Atlas Walker, Tri-wheel Walker, Adjustable Forearm Walker.
Spans pressure care items (Lambswool Bed Pad, Heel Protectors) and specialist seating (Hospital Bedside Chair, Leather Recliner).
Commode chairs and seats for toileting—NHSSC-referenced stainless steel and standard models (4750/CV, Romachair).
Transit, self-propelled, junior, ambulance wheelchairs—Wisp 1650, 1640, Elevating Legrest.
Heavy-duty shower chairs and mobile commodes—5626 Perch Stool, Heavy Duty Mobile Shower Chair, Heavy Duty Commode.
Electric powerchairs—EP30+, EP50+, Roma Rhodes, Roma Athens.
Paediatric walking frames and rollators—Paediatric Adjustable Tripod, Coloured Paediatric Walker.
Specialist seating for patient transport—Woburn Porter Chair, Blenheim Porter Chair.
